# Three.js

Version: 0.180.0 (r180).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

License: MIT; see LICENSE in this directory.

Only the core modules, OrbitControls, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, and RoomEnvironment are bundled. Bare package imports in the example modules are changed to relative imports to the bundled build. No external CDN or build step is needed at runtime.

Official documentation:

- https://threejs.org/docs/pages/WebGLRenderer.html
- https://threejs.org/docs/pages/GLTFLoader.html
- https://threejs.org/docs/pages/OrbitControls.html
